modern: How much trouble he avoids who does not look to see what his neighbour says or does or thinks, but only at what he does himself, that it may be just and pure; or, as Agathon says, do not look round at the corrupt morals of others, but run straight along the line without swerving from it.
original: How much trouble he avoids who does not look to see what his neighbor says or does or thinks, but only to what he does himself, that it may be just and pure; or, as Agathon says, look not round at the depraved morals of others, but run straight along the line without deviating from it.
